title: test(app-shell): unmount before unstubbing fetch in the ImpersonationBanner test

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXpPPZiBKyj1HzrdQ6La3ZH)_
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUR8Nu4M7tbtgES7q2

Fixes #30434

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 `ImpersonationBanner.test.tsx` 一个测试文件：`afterEach` 先 `cleanup()` 卸载组件，再 `vi.unstubAllGlobals()` 撤掉 fetch 替身；另加一条用例，钉住测试体结束后才发出的 `sys_user` 读取仍落到替身。
- 为什么改：原顺序先撤替身、后由根 setup 卸载，卸载时补跑的读取打到真实 `localhost:3000`，网络逃逸守卫随机把无关 PR 的 `Test UI` 判红（PR #30417 就为此白查一轮）。
- 风险与回滚：仅测试代码，不进任何发布包；回滚即 revert 本提交。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ImpersonationBanner.test.tsx` 的 `afterEach` 与文件末尾新增用例。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ImpersonationBanner.test.tsx`，预期 14 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（PR 需带 `skip-changeset` 标签）。

## What changes

- `afterEach` now calls RTL `cleanup()` before `vi.unstubAllGlobals()`. Vitest runs this file's hook before the root setup's `cleanup()` and before the network-escape guard. With the old order the tree was still mounted when the real `fetch` came back, so a banner `sys_user` read whose effect was still pending when the body returned went out during that cleanup's act-flush. That is the shape the guard's message names (objectui#7439). The banner issues `fetch` synchronously inside its effect, so once the tree is unmounted nothing in this file can issue a read. Cleanup-first is therefore enough, and it is the smaller of the two shapes the guard offers.
- New case `a read that lands AFTER the test body still reaches the double, never the network`. A small probe issues the banner's own administrator read (same URL, same `createAuthenticatedFetch` lane) from its unmount. That is the exact moment the teardown order decides. An `onTestFinished` check, which runs after every `afterEach` including the guard, asserts the double served it. A probe stands in for the banner's effect because React's passive-effect timing cannot be held open on purpose. The probe lands a read in that window every time.
- `ImpersonationBanner.tsx` is not touched.

## Tests

- File on the fix: 14/14 passed (13 before plus the new case).
- Positive control: the old teardown order restored through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which records the mutation on disk and restores from HEAD. The new case goes red twice, and the other 13 stay green.
- Stability: 20 consecutive runs of the file, 20/20 green, with zero `Network escape` lines across all 20 logs.

## Acceptance notes

- `skip-changeset`: test-only. The file is under `src/**/__tests__` and is not shipped in any package's published files.
- Local `type-check` of `@object-ui/app-shell` (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) was NOT MEASURED. In this container the sibling `@object-ui/*` packages are unbuilt, so every error is TS2307 module resolution, including those in untouched files. CI's `Type Check UI` lane covers it.
